goo.known_items.title: Known Items
item.goo.goo_label.tooltip: Holds a canister or vat to %s goo
item.goo.smithing_template.exorite_upgra: Add netherite armor, weapon, or tool
goo.ability.yore.rewind.description: Rewinds a mob, freezing it while held, then turning it into a baby or its spawn egg.
goo.ability.yore.expire.description: Kills the struck mob outright, bosses excepted.
goo.ability.yore.ancient.description: No damage can take you below half a heart.
goo.ability.yore.age.description: Starts aging the block it strikes, which slowly becomes something older, such as coal into diamond.
goo.ability.blaze.kindle.description: Ember hearts shield your ash hearts, which reignite by how many embers remain.
goo.ability.blaze.flames.description: Hold to channel a stream of fire that cooks what it touches.
goo.ability.crystal.cloud.description: A floating dome of razor crystals slices anything that moves inside it.
goo.ability.crystal.knives.description: Hold to gather a fan of glass knives, then release to sling them.
goo.ability.crystal.glitter.description: Hold to detect nearby gemstone ores.
goo.ability.crystal.scales.description: Crystal shells on your hearts block damage before it reaches your life.
goo.ability.crystal.prism.description: Grows a prism where it lands, which reacts with other goo types.
goo.ability.astral.meteo.description: Calls a meteor down; it crashes through whatever stands above.
goo.ability.astral.scry.description: Hold to see the spaces around you.
goo.ability.deep.shriek.description: A blob that shrieks like a sculk shrieker and calls every hostile mob in earshot to it while it lasts; other mobs pay it no mind.
goo.ability.deep.click.description: Throw your voice: a click travels to wherever you look and sounds there, tripping sculk sensors and drawing a warden to the spot without pointing it back at you.
goo.ability.deep.sculker.description: Sense the world the way the deep does and swim through solid ground: sneak and jump together to dive in, swim with your movement keys, jump to rise and sneak to sink, and jump clear of a top face to stand on solid ground again. Stone never suffocates you while it lasts.
goo.ability.ender.zone.description: Curses a mob with teleportitis so it cannot reach you.
goo.ability.ender.blink.description: Teleports you a short way; blinking to a prism makes an Oculus.
goo.ability.ender.blink.cost_mechanics: Plus %s per block travelled and %s more through a wall; Oculus Blinks cost %s percent.
goo.ability.ender.end.description: Opens a temporary portal to the End.
goo.ability.ender.shifter.description: When a mob or projectile would hurt you, you blink to a random safe spot within 8 blocks, facing a random way.
goo.ability.quantum.phase.description: Puts you out of phase: mobs lose you, and only same-phase creatures can trade hits.
goo.ability.quantum.phase_shift.descript: Puts a struck mob out of phase, so it hits and targets only its own side.
goo.ability.quantum.tunnel.description: Opens a wormhole from the struck wall to the opening beyond, up to 32 blocks, for thirty seconds.
goo.ability.quantum.portal.description: Opens a portal that links with your last unpaired one; sneak right click two portals to relink.
goo.ability.quantum.swap.description: Blinks you where you aim, leaving a swap body behind; cast again to trade places with it.
goo.ability.quantum.link.description: Links your next two struck mobs, mirroring health and status effects between them.
goo.ability.frost.nova.description: Hold to charge a frost nova that freezes and damages nearby mobs.
goo.ability.frost.cold.description: Hold to blow cold wind that freezes mobs.
goo.ability.frost.orb.description: A slow orb freezes mobs, water and lava in its path, ending in a frost nova.
goo.ability.frost.iceborn.description: Frozen hearts take damage first but are weak to physical hits, and you become extremely endothermic.
goo.ability.glow.crystal.description: Places a flat glowing crystal where its ray strikes; prisms become skyward beams.
goo.ability.glow.sunbeam.description: Hold a damaging light beam; prisms become reflectors that split it and light the gaps between them.
goo.ability.glow.lux.description: Grants night vision, and mobs you look at glow.
goo.ability.glow.radiant.description: Hold to flood the dark air around you with fading wisps of light.
goo.ability.hex.charm.description: Charms a mob to follow you and fight whatever targets you, until you hurt it.
goo.ability.hex.enchant.description: Enchants one book you carry at random, possibly with a curse.
goo.ability.hex.fuse.description: Fuses two identical enchanted books you carry into one a level higher.
goo.ability.hex.lifetap.description: Damage you deal heals you, but food no longer regenerates your health.
goo.ability.hex.drain.description: Hold to drain health from the creatures in a wide cone ahead.
goo.ability.jelly.heal.description: Channel a stream that heals you and every living thing in its cone.
goo.ability.jelly.gluttony.description: Healing past full becomes extra hearts, and eating past full banks hunger that refills as it drops.
goo.ability.jelly.reserve.description: Channel to bank health and hunger, at a loss, into reserves spent before your own.
goo.ability.jelly.feed.description: Feeds an animal that draws nearby mobs, the hostile ones fighting over it.
goo.ability.leaf.barkskin.description: Regrowing bark hearts shield yours and thorn melee attackers, but fire and axes hit them hard.
goo.ability.leaf.vines.description: Thorny vines root a mob, leaving it weak to fire, or lie on the ground as a trap.
goo.ability.leaf.bloom.description: Spawns plants by chance around where the blob strikes.
goo.ability.leaf.growth.description: Channel a breeze that grows plants in its cone, speeds Barkskin's regrowth and infuses prisms.
goo.ability.leaf.reap.description: Harvests ripe crops around where the blob strikes, replanting any that drop a seed.
goo.ability.leaf.bio.description: A toxin drains a share of a mob's max health over time, stacking twice and refreshing on hit.
goo.ability.metal.javelin.description: The blob becomes a dart in flight, stabbing a mob for moderate damage.
goo.ability.metal.magnet.description: Hold to sense nearby metal ores.
goo.ability.metal.spikes.description: Throws a spike trap that impales nearby creatures until its spears run out.
goo.ability.nether.black_hole.descriptio: A black hole pulls in everything, items too, and compresses what it destroys into a dense ball.
goo.ability.nether.decay.description: Hold to spray nether motes that gnaw away whatever they touch.
goo.ability.nether.undead.description: Fast-regenerating nether hearts fill your missing ones, but you count as undead and burn in sunlight.
goo.ability.pulse.extender.description: Your other sustained self-effects skip their upkeep every other tick.
goo.ability.pulse.pulser.description: Channel to rapidly toggle levers, buttons, doors and gates in your aim; prisms become metronomes.
goo.ability.pulse.zap.description: Ticks the redstone it hits, pulses through walls, and turns prisms into wireless relays.
goo.ability.rock.bore.description: Channel a narrow stream that tunnels through mundane blocks and hurts the mobs inside.
goo.ability.rock.flatten.description: Hold on a block face to clear the blocks around until they lie level with it.
goo.ability.rock.petrify.description: Channel a fog that slowly turns mobs to stone and hardens exposed blocks.
goo.ability.rock.spire.description: Drag a rectangle to raise stone from the ground as walls or other blocks.
goo.ability.rock.terrakinesis.descriptio: Hold to tear a chunk of earth from the ground, then left click to hurl it.
goo.ability.rock.stoneskin.description: Stone hearts fill your missing ones and resist blows, but explosions and pickaxes crack them and regeneration stops.
goo.ability.shroom.mycosis.description: Spray spores that poison, slow and weaken mobs, which burst into spores on death.
goo.ability.shroom.colonize.description: The blob spreads the shroom network it lands on, or buds a new one, infecting nearby mobs.
goo.ability.shroom.fungal_shift.descript: Near a fungus, move to the fungus block you aim at.
goo.ability.shroom.sight.description: Transmit reaches three times farther, and you see fungus blocks through walls.
goo.ability.kinetic.grab.description: Lifts the mob or item you look at; look down to pull it closer, left click to throw.
goo.ability.kinetic.slick.description: Held stream lays a slippery film on floors that speeds up whatever slides on it.
goo.ability.kinetic.telekinesis.descript: You reach blocks and entities from farther away.
goo.ability.typhoon.float.description: You fly along your look and strafe keys, fall slowly without damage, and jump higher.
goo.ability.typhoon.pneuma.description: While held, refills your air and banks the overflow as a reserve for when you cannot breathe.
goo.ability.typhoon.gust.description: Channel a wind that pushes mobs in its cone away along your aim.
goo.ability.typhoon.updraft.description: Places a column of air that lifts entities upward; prisms become Floatstones.
goo.ability.unstable.buster.description: Your melee hits strike every living thing nearby, and each block you break breaks its neighbors.
goo.ability.unstable.explode.description: Explodes where the goo lands; hold on a block face and drag for a bigger blast.
goo.ability.unstable.lurker.description: A proximity mine that pulses as creatures near, then explodes.
goo.ability.weird.goop.description: Held slime makes floors bouncy, cools source lava to magma, and leaves struck mobs dealing only knockback.
goo.ability.void.erase.description: Removes the struck mob from the world, with no reward.
goo.ability.void.hole.description: Opens a hole on a floor that stands open temporarily and keeps every item thrown in; opened on a ceiling it pours them all back out.
goo.ability.void.outsider.description: Hold to enter your own dimension and, inside, to widen it on every side; the doorway takes you back.
goo.ability.void.outsider.cost_mechanics: %s void to enter. Inside, holding on costs void each second, rising as the room grows.
goo.ability.weird.mitosis.description: The blob becomes a small slime where it lands.
goo.ability.xeno.eldritch.description: Makes you eldritch: you see things out of phase, and they see you.
goo.ability.zoo.allure.description: Drives an animal to mate, if it can.
goo.ability.zoo.leader.description: Senses every creature around you through walls with its health, and peaceful ones follow you.
goo.ability.zoo.rally.description: The peaceful creature it lands on fights your enemies with more health and speed, until you strike it.
goo.ability.zoo.shape.description: Turns a slime into a random peaceful mob of its biome.
goo.ability.zoo.spawn.description: Turns a struck slime into a random hostile mob of its biome.
goo.ability.cost_mechanics.upkeep: Costs nothing to start, then %s a second until you invoke it again or run dry.
goo.ability.param.cost.cost.description: Goo in mB that one use of the ability costs.
goo.ability.param.cost_per_block.cost_pe: Goo in mB added to the cost for each block the blink travels.
goo.ability.param.node_percent.node_perc: Percent of the full price a Blink to an Oculus costs, 100 for the full price.
goo.ability.param.upkeep.upkeep.descript: The mB the held effect drains each tick it stands.
goo.ability.param.wall_cost.wall_cost.de: The mB added to a blink's cost when it passes through a solid block.
goo.ability.param.outsider.cell_cost.des: Void goo in mB a platform cell costs at the room's center.
goo.ability.param.outsider.distance_cost: Void goo in mB each block a cell stands from the room's center adds to its cost.
goo.ability.param.outsider.enter.descrip: Void goo in mB the trip into your pocket room costs.
